videos.headline: DJ Uiagalelei connects with Jack Veilling for Oregon State TD
videos.description: Oregon State QB DJ Uiagalelei slings a 22-yard touchdown pass to Jack Velling to give the Beavers the lead.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (DJ Uiagalelei connects with Jack Veilling for Oregon State TD) 2023/10/28 ESHEET

videos.headline: Noah Fifita connects with Malachi Riley for a big Arizona play
videos.description: Arizona QB Noah Fifita tosses a 40-yard pass to Malachi Riley to get the Wildcats to near midfield.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Noah Fifita connects with Malachi Riley for a big Arizona play) 2023/10/28 ESHEET

videos.headline: Arizona grabs lead on Noah Fifita's TD pass
videos.description: Arizona QB Noah Fifita bides his time to find Tetairoa McMillan for a seven-yard touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Arizona grabs lead on Noah Fifita's TD pass) 2023/10/28 ESHEET

videos.headline: Oregon State converts long 3rd down with a 52-yard pass

videos.headline: Arizona's Jacob Manu deflects pass without even looking

videos.headline: Uiagalelei lobs TD pass to Valsin to keep Oregon State in it
